summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K dated October 20, 2026, furnishing a UK-style PDMR (persons discharging managerial responsibilities) disclosure — the US-equivalent Form 4 insider-transaction notice. Director of Operations Zafar Khan acquired 1,445 ordinary shares of 25p at GBP 20.76 on October 19, 2026, following exercise of options under the 2021 BAT 3 Year Sharesave Scheme, an aggregate GBP 29,998.20. The transaction occurred outside a trading venue. No board recommendation, advisor, pricing negotiation or deal structure is involved; this is routine share-plan administration, with no risk-arb angle.
